methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote:
The VSNavigator is a web platform for public 
school stakeholders that provides the tools necessary 
to develop and implement an Energy Management 
Program at organizational and building levels with 
respect to both policy and building operation.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/software and action-management framework without a characterised EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote:
The 
successfully integration of these ICTs realizes a complete Energy Navigator system; in practice a web based 
platform called VSNavigator.

stage1.notes: The paper describes an ISO 50001 school-management platform, energy-flow visualisation, targets, and action workflows, but no EnPI/EnB model variables, functional form, or estimation method.
